item.title: Ofgem scheduled energy price cap announcement (Jan–Mar 2027)
item.description: Ofgem says it will announce the cap for 1 January–31 March 2027 by 25 November 2026. It may publish sooner. This is an announcement date, not a payment or personal entitlement. Source: https://www.ofgem.gov.uk/news/changes-energy-price-cap-between-1-october-and-31-december-2026 · Reviewed: 2026-11-17
